pageTitle: HGL Blueprint — Design, review, then build
realExampleTitle: Repair an out-of-bounds access and improve stability
travelerQuote: A good system begins with one clear requirement.
heroTitle: Design first. Build only after approval.
heroCopy: HGL Blueprint turns your requirement into a validated, reusable, and auditable system contract.
stepOneCopy: Natural language is enough. Be specific about the outcome.
starterPrompt: Use $harness-graph-loop-builder to design a reviewable HGL Blueprint for my goal. Do not build until I approve.
stepTwoCopy: Nothing is built before you inspect the contract.
intentDetail: Defines the goal, non-goals, inputs, outputs, and acceptance criteria.
harnessDetail: Limits tools, permissions, context, budgets, recovery, and external effects.
graphDetail: Connects only real dependencies, fan-out, fan-in, failure routes, and independent review.
loopDetail: Uses verification feedback to improve a bounded attempt, then stops within a finite budget.
evidenceDetail: Persists compact, traceable records so another operator can verify or resume the work.
workflowTitle: From requirement to Evidence, with validation and a human gate built in.
workflowTitleTail: , with validation and a human gate built in.
workflowIntent: Clarify the problem and explicit boundaries.
workflowCore: Choose the smallest justified Harness, Graph, and Loop.
workflowVerifier: Bind every acceptance criterion to a real check.
workflowEvidence: Persist compact, traceable proof instead of transcripts.
safetyLine: Before human approval, generation and external effects remain locked.
exampleTitle: A code repair workflow that can prove it is done.
exampleCopy: The included example isolates diagnosis, repair, verification, and independent review without sharing full chat history.
repairIntentCopy: Ensure the limit never exceeds users.size().
